description:
Digitized civil and mechanical workflows (ISO drawings, spools, welding joints, material listings, and QA/QC image inspections) for 500+ employees on the proprietary UWIS platform.

Engineered automated Excel report generation and maintained a robust Django backend deployed via Apache WSGI. Administered the Ubuntu host server and minimized page load latency through comprehensive database indexing and other methods to meet strict performance priorities.

Pagination and indexing were important, as the DB was huge, containing 1000s of records as shown in the reference pictures and was updated in real-time by many employees concurrently.
name: Smart UWIS

description:
A custom CRM for musictutorship.in, to help the founder Vijay automate lead tracking and course management. Along with automated class (google meet) scheduling via a google service account, updating google calendars of all parties involved.

Upstash Redis and the resend API came in handy to help us in sending automated email reminders, and other marketing emails. Handling multiple emails, leads, and users wasn't an issue as our Go Fiber server was the Request threading king.

This project helped him save 10x of his time and allowed him to have his entire focus on his true passion that is teaching music.
name: MusicTutorship CRM
